description: Wallet Watch: never run dry mid-job. Register an agent's Base wallet with min_usdc and/or min_days (runway at its recent spend rate); OMENZ checks it daily for up to 30 days and drops ONE alert into your Agent PO Box when it runs low (re-arms after you top up). Read-only public chain data; never touches the wallet. Returns watch_id + watch_key (shown once). By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/wallet-watch, $0.01 via x402.)

days.description: how many days to keep it (1-30)
